header: An explanation on one side, the links on the other
bodytext:
The band for a section that has to say what it is before it lists itself. The rich text sits in one half, the destinations in the other, and a toggle swaps the two sides from the tablet breakpoint upwards.

Below that width there is only one column, and the intro always comes first — the swap is a layout decision, never a reading-order one.

items.title: The intro leads in the source
items.description: Whichever side it ends up on

items.title: The link column keeps its own rhythm
items.description: It never wraps into the prose beside it

items.title: Rich text, not a lead line
items.description: Two or three paragraphs are what this band is for

items.title: Two to twelve destinations
items.description: More than that belongs in a Page List Menu
